ownerExtraction.seedCoordinateSystem: source PNG pixel coordinates before crop-to-target resize

waterMask.candidateRule: Non-dark pixel is a candidate when it has blue/green sea tint, nearest water-seed RGB distance < 2600, and is at least 28% closer to a water sample than to any faction land seed color.
waterMask.darkTextTerrainFill: Dark/text pixels are not direct water candidates; after connected water grow, dark pixels inherit nearest classified terrain through BFS.

waterMaskRules.waterFunction: makeSourceMasks(png, crop, seeds) -> seeded connected water mask
waterMaskRules.preliminaryWaterFunction: isPreliminaryWaterPixel(rgb), used only to avoid picking obvious water while resolving faction seed sample colors
waterMaskRules.computedOn: source PNG crop pixels before nearest-neighbor resize
waterMaskRules.possibleHreFailure: If HRE is still water, the candidate rule is still too broad or connected water leaks inland through candidate corridors.
waterMaskRules.resizeNote: terrain.bin is created by nearest-neighbor resizing the source water mask; target water ratio should stay close to source water ratio.

ownerClassification.method: region seed flood fill; political boundary mask and water mask are barriers
ownerClassification.fillUnassignedLand: After all region seeds expand, remaining non-water pixels such as boundary/text pixels inherit the nearest neighboring assigned region through BFS.
